svg.title: 09-reference-information
svg.desc: Actual input-basis silicon structures: the short reference has24atoms in3conventional cells with1selected interacting cell; the longer representative periodic construction has152atoms in19cells with17selected interacting cells. All atomic positions and dashed periodic-cell faces come from the verified silicon input renderer. The structures use independent orthographic view scales, with lengths explicitly labelled. Short interaction-region length0.543356003nm and full length1.630068009nm; long interacting length9.237052051nm and full length10.323764057nm; conventional repeat0.543356003nm. The arrow proposes transfer of reference lattice-response information to the repeated crystal; the populations remain to be determined. This is an explanatory construction, not a calculated temperature profile or a new transport result.
